status: frozen before original-D2 routed DEV evaluation
scope: Jenga DEV only; frozen TEST prohibited
evaluation_unit: each of the three D2-selected opposite-response pairs for every frozen-v0 initial DEV candidate
causal_pair_input: current state 61 + original nominal action 8x4 + twice the initial endpoint action difference 8x3; the factor two matches the D3 initial alpha width of 0.5

routing_application.identity: leave all six D2 early/full refinement gaps unchanged
routing_application.correction: leave level zero unchanged and multiply levels 1..5 by exp of the selected TRAIN residual prototype for early-hold/full-hold
routing_application.boundary: recompute the unchanged calibration-free boundary BIC from corrected gaps
routing_application.consequence: combine corrected per-pair boundary signs with the unchanged D2 commitment and persistence evidence; majority of three pairs alarms
routing_application.unchanged: initial candidate discovery, pair selection, midpoint path, predicted endpoint trajectories, commitment, persistence and all v0 constants

arms: future-informed physical-gap cost oracle for descriptive upper bound
physical_cost_oracle: grading-only: replay the exact D2-selected nested endpoint paths in MuJoCo and choose per pair the option minimizing equally normalized physical-vs-corrected early/full log-ratio global and local Huber cost
task_information: topple/fork/quiet classes are joined after decisions for grading only and never enter routers, corrections or option costs
primary_summary: median across ten fixed router seeds; fixed final TRAIN epoch; no seed or epoch selection on DEV

feasibility_gate.interpretation: all conditions must pass before expanding the routed monitor or considering TEST

reporting: report all v0 class counts and candidate/boundary/commitment/persistence/final stages; do not tune after seeing DEV
